decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-688 MODIFY that fully records the accepted first-mint exclusion and resulting 11-commission total.
Its existing state already requires random allocation to an existing NFT and excludes mint #1 when no earlier NFT exists.
The existing message-688 MODIFY already records crediting the randomly selected token ID after processRandomReferral executes.
Crediting a code-used ticket to the referrer's NFT is already the candidate's current recipient rule.
The accounting decision does not necessarily revise published FAQ copy, and no new copy instruction is given.
The accepted mint-accounting and recipient-credit rules do not change the Small Block prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility window, or funding rules.
The source resolves backend accounting logic but does not direct any change to About-page content.
The candidate already requires credited tickets and commissions to appear in NFT attributes, while message 688 supplies a runtime failure for that unchanged requirement rather than a new value rule.
Ticket and commission accounting after a mint does not change which referral codes are valid or the validation feedback.
The accepted code-used accounting credit is consistent with the existing referral-recipient rule and does not change automatic wallet payout behavior.
Mint ticket accounting does not alter automatic prize delivery or introduce a claim interaction.
Random selection of a no-referral ticket recipient is distinct from VRF selection of prize-draw winners and does not change the latter.
